title: Aduro Clean Technologies annonce la clôture de sa cotation au Nasdaq pour un montant de 4 millions de dollars
description: Aduro Clean Technologies, a clean technology company, has announced the closing of its $4 million public offering on the Nasdaq exchange. The company plans to use the proceeds to fund ongoing research and development, as well as the construction of its new generation industrial facility.

title: Aduro Clean Technologies gibt Abschluss des Uplistings in Höhe von 4 Mio. USD an der Nasdaq bekannt
description: Aduro Clean Technologies, a clean technology company, has announced the closing of its guaranteed public offering in the United States, raising approximately $4 million in gross proceeds. The company plans to use the net proceeds for ongoing research and development and the construction of its 'Next Generation Process' facility.

title: Aduro Clean Technologies präsentiert die Hydrochemolytic™-Technologie als innovative Lösung für das chemische Recycling auf der Advanced Recycling Conference 2024
description: Aduro Clean Technologies will present its Hydrochemolytic™ technology, a water-based chemical recycling solution for complex plastic waste, at the Advanced Recycling Conference 2024 in Cologne, Germany. The technology aims to address long-standing challenges in chemical recycling by enabling selective breakdown of mixed plastics into valuable hydrocarbons while removing contaminants in a single optimized process.

title: Aduro Clean Technologies présentera la technologie Hydrochemolytic™ en tant que solution innovante pour le recyclage chimique lors de l’Advanced Recycling Conference 2024
description: Aduro Clean Technologies will present its Hydrochemolytic™ technology as an alternative to pyrolysis for chemical recycling of complex and contaminated plastic waste at the Advanced Recycling Conference 2024 in Cologne, Germany.

title: Aduro Clean Technologies gibt die Abstimmungsergebnisse für die Wahl der Direktoren bekannt
description: Aduro Clean Technologies Inc. announced the election of its directors at the annual general meeting. The company develops water-based technologies to chemically recycle plastic waste, upgrade heavy crude oil and bitumen, and convert renewable oils into higher-value fuels or chemicals.

title: Aduro Clean Technologies annonce les résultats du vote pour l’élection des administrateurs
description: Aduro Clean Technologies Inc. announced the election of its board of directors at the 2023/2024 annual general meeting. The company develops water-based technologies to chemically recycle plastic waste, convert heavy crude oil and bitumen into lighter and higher-value oil, and transform renewable oils into higher-value fuels or renewable chemicals.

title: Aduro Clean Technologies Announces Partial Exercise of Over-Allotment Option
description: Aduro Clean Technologies announced that the underwriters of its U.S. public offering have partially exercised their over-allotment option, resulting in the sale of an additional 100,000 common shares for gross proceeds of approximately $4.43 million. The company plans to use the net proceeds for research and development, construction of its 'Next Generation Process' unit, and general corporate purposes.

title: Aduro Clean Technologies Announces Second Partial Exercise of Over-Allotment Option
description: Aduro Clean Technologies announced that the underwriters of its U.S. public offering have partially exercised their over-allotment option, resulting in the sale of an additional 22,470 common shares for gross proceeds of approximately $4.52 million. The company plans to use the net proceeds for research and development, construction of its 'Next Generation Process' unit, and general corporate purposes.
